rows.question: What is the minimum password length?
rows.answer: According to [1], the minimum password length is 14 characters.

rows.question: Do I need to change my password every 90 days?
rows.answer: No, you must change a password only when there is evidence or suspicion that it has been compromised [2].

rows.question: Can I get MFA codes by text message?
rows.answer: No, SMS and voice codes are not allowed for MFA, except as a temporary fallback issued by the Service Desk for at most 7 days [1].

rows.question: I keep getting sign-in approval requests on my phone that I didn't trigger. What should I do?
rows.answer: According to policy [3], if you receive an MFA prompt you did not start, you should deny it and report it as a Security Incident. Please report this to the Service Desk immediately.

rows.question: How long am I locked out after typing the wrong password too many times?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], you are locked out for 30 minutes after 10 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes. To unlock it sooner, contact the Service Desk.

rows.question: Can the help desk unlock my account if I just message them on chat?
rows.answer: No, the help desk cannot unlock your account based only on a chat message. According to [1], agents must verify your identity by video call with your company ID badge, or by confirmation from your line manager, before unlocking an account.

rows.question: Which password manager are we supposed to use?
rows.answer: According to [1], 1Password Business is the only approved password manager for work credentials.

rows.question: Is it OK to let Chrome remember my work password?
rows.answer: No, it is not allowed. According to [1], saving work passwords in browser password stores (Chrome, Edge or Safari) is not allowed.

rows.question: How long do admin account passwords need to be?
rows.answer: Admin account passwords must be at least 20 characters long [1].

rows.question: What happens to an adm- account that hasn't been used for a while?
rows.answer: According to [1], admin accounts are reviewed every quarter and are disabled after 45 days without use. This means that if an adm- account hasn't been used for 45 days, it will be disabled.

rows.question: I think someone stole my password. How fast do I need to report it?
rows.answer: You need to report it within 1 hour [1]. Raise a ticket in the Security Incident category or call the security hotline on ext. 7100. The Service Desk will force a password reset and sign you out of all sessions. Do not wait until you are sure.

rows.question: I lost the phone with my authenticator app. How do I sign in?
rows.answer: To sign in, contact the Service Desk and they will issue a Temporary Access Pass, valid for 8 hours, so you can register a new device [1]. This will allow you to access your account temporarily while you set up a new authenticator device.

rows.question: Can I run a torrent client on my work laptop?
rows.answer: No, you cannot run a torrent client on your work laptop. According to the Acceptable Use Policy [1], torrent clients are not permitted on company devices or the company network.

rows.question: Is AnyDesk allowed?
rows.answer:
No, remote-control tools such as AnyDesk are not allowed on company devices. [1]

Instead, use Kestrel Assist for remote support. [1]

rows.question: Can I use my own NordVPN subscription on the company laptop?
rows.answer: According to policy [4], personal or consumer VPN services are prohibited on company devices. KestrelConnect is the only VPN allowed. Therefore, you cannot use your own NordVPN subscription on the company laptop.

rows.question: Can I paste customer data into ChatGPT to summarise it?
rows.answer: No, you may not paste customer data into any AI tool, including ChatGPT. [1] Customer data is classified as Restricted, and according to the Acceptable Use Policy, you must not paste Restricted data into any AI tool.

rows.question: What kind of data can I use with Kestrel Copilot?
rows.answer: You may use Kestrel Copilot with any data classified up to Confidential [1]. This means you can use it with Internal and Confidential data, but not Restricted data [2].

rows.question: Can I set up a rule to forward my work email to my Gmail?
rows.answer: No, you cannot set up a rule to forward your work email to your personal Gmail mailbox. [1]

rows.question: How long are web proxy logs kept?
rows.answer: According to [1], web proxy logs are kept for 180 days for security purposes.

rows.question: Does the company read my personal messages on my work laptop?
rows.answer: According to policy [4], the content of personal communications is not read routinely. An investigation into an individual needs approval from both HR and the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

rows.question: What does error VPN-809 mean?
rows.answer: Error VPN-809 means your network is blocking UDP port 51820. Switch to a different network or a mobile hotspot; hotel and guest networks often block this port. [1]

rows.question: My VPN says my certificate expired. How do I fix it?
rows.answer:
To fix the issue, follow these steps:

1. Connect to the internet.
2. Open Company Portal.
3. Choose Sync.
4. Reconnect to the VPN.

This should resolve the issue. [2]

rows.question: How do I fix VPN-127?
rows.answer: To fix VPN-127 (MFA rejected), retry and approve the MFA prompt within 60 seconds [1]. If the prompt expires, try again. If the issue persists, raise a ticket in the Network/VPN category and include the error code.
unsupported_claims: If the issue persists, raise a ticket in the Network/VPN category and include the error code.

rows.question: Do I need to be on the VPN to check my email?
rows.answer: No, you don't need to be on the VPN to check your email. According to [1], SaaS tools behind single sign-on, such as email, work without the VPN.

rows.question: I'm working from a hotel this week. Do I have to use the VPN?
rows.answer: According to policy [2], when using public or hotel Wi-Fi, KestrelConnect must be switched on for all traffic. This is to ensure secure access to internal systems and protect company data.

rows.question: Why doesn't my Zoom call traffic go through the VPN?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], Microsoft Teams and Zoom media traffic are excluded automatically to protect call quality. This is a standard exception to ensure smooth communication.

rows.question: I want to work from Portugal for a month. What do I need to do?
rows.answer: To work from Portugal for a month, you need to submit a Travel Notice form in the service portal at least 10 business days before your trip [1]. Since Portugal is not mentioned as a high-risk country, you can use your primary laptop [1].
unsupported_claims: Since Portugal is not mentioned as a high-risk country, you can use your primary laptop

rows.question: How many days a year can I work remotely from another country?
rows.answer: According to the Remote Access and VPN Policy [1], working remotely from abroad is limited to 30 days per calendar year unless HR approves more in writing.

rows.question: What are the Wi-Fi security requirements for working from home?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], your home Wi-Fi must use WPA2-AES or WPA3 with a non-default password, and the router firmware must be kept up to date.

rows.question: Which port does KestrelConnect need to be open?
rows.answer: According to [1], KestrelConnect uses WireGuard and needs UDP port 51820 to be open for the VPN handshake to succeed.

rows.question: What laptop do data scientists get?
rows.answer: According to the Device and Endpoint Policy (IT-OPS-004), section 1. Standard Hardware, page 1, engineering and data roles receive a MacBook Pro 14-inch with 32 GB of memory. [1]

rows.question: How often are laptops replaced?
rows.answer:
Laptops are refreshed every 4 years, and engineering laptops every 3 years. Earlier replacement needs a hardware fault confirmed by the Service Desk. [1]

For engineering roles, laptops are refreshed every 3 years. [1]

For all other roles, laptops are refreshed every 4 years. [1]

rows.question: Where can I get my BitLocker recovery key?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], your BitLocker recovery key is stored in Microsoft Intune, and the Service Desk can retrieve it after verifying your identity.

rows.question: How do I get admin rights on my Mac to install something?
rows.answer:
To get admin rights on your Mac, follow these steps:

1. Raise a Software request through the Company Portal self-service catalogue, as the application you need may not be available [1].
2. If the software is missing, request temporary admin rights through a Privileged Access Request [1].
3. Temporary admin rights are granted for 4 hours at a time and every use is logged [1].
unsupported_claims: To get admin rights on your Mac, follow these steps: 1. Raise a Software request through the Company Portal self-service catalogue...

rows.question: How long does it take to approve software that isn't in Company Portal?
rows.answer: According to [1], new software is reviewed for security and licensing within 5 business days.

rows.question: Can I read work email on my personal iPhone?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can read work email on your personal iPhone through the Intune app protection policy. [1]

You don't need to enroll your whole device, just use the Intune app to access work email. [1]

Note that personal laptops and desktops must not be used to access source code, the data warehouse, or any Restricted data. [1]

You can use your iPhone for personal activities during breaks, as long as it doesn't affect your work or break any other policy. [3]

rows.question: Can I clone our git repositories onto my personal laptop?
rows.answer: No, you may not clone our Git repositories onto your personal laptop. According to policy [1], personal laptops and desktops must not be used to access source code.

rows.question: My laptop was stolen from my car. What should I do?
rows.answer: Report the stolen laptop to the Service Desk on ext. 4357 or raise a P1 ticket from another device within 2 hours [1]. If the laptop was stolen, file a police report and add the report number to the ticket within 3 days [1]. Disconnect from the network by turning off Wi-Fi or unplugging the cable, but do not shut down the laptop [2]. Call the security hotline on ext. 7100 straight away [2]. Write down what you clicked and when [2].
unsupported_claims: Disconnect from the network by turning off Wi-Fi or unplugging the cable, but do not shut down the laptop

rows.question: How quickly do critical security updates have to be installed?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], critical security updates must be installed within 72 hours.

rows.question: Why can't I sign in to any apps? My laptop hasn't been updated in a month.
rows.answer: Your laptop is likely blocked from single sign-on due to being out of compliance with operating system and browser updates. According to policy [2], devices that are more than 21 days out of compliance are blocked from single sign-on until they are updated. Please update your laptop and try signing in again.

rows.question: When do I have to send my laptop back after resigning?
rows.answer: According to the Device and Endpoint Policy [1], you must return your laptop, security keys, and accessories within 5 business days of your last working day.

rows.question: Is customer personal data Confidential or Restricted?
rows.answer: According to [1], customer personal data is classified as Restricted.

rows.question: Can I keep a spreadsheet of customer phone numbers on my laptop?
rows.answer:
According to policy [1], Confidential data may be stored in company SharePoint, OneDrive and approved SaaS tools. A spreadsheet of customer phone numbers is considered Confidential data. Therefore, you can store it in company OneDrive.

However, please note that you should not store Restricted data on your laptop, as per policy [1]. If the spreadsheet contains any Restricted data, you should not store it on your laptop.
unsupported_claims: A spreadsheet of customer phone numbers is considered Confidential data.
If the spreadsheet contains any Restricted data, you should not store it on your laptop.

rows.question: How do I share a contract with a vendor?
rows.answer: To share a contract with a vendor, you need to follow the Data Classification and Handling Policy [3]. Since contracts typically contain Confidential data, you need a signed NDA from the vendor. Once you have the NDA, you can share the contract through SharePoint links that expire after 30 days [3].

rows.question: Can I use a USB stick to move some files?
rows.answer: No, you cannot use a USB stick to move files by default. An exception is required, which needs approval from your manager and Information Security, and only company-issued encrypted USB drives may be used. Exceptions expire after 90 days [1].

rows.question: How long do we keep customer data after a contract ends?
rows.answer: According to the Data Classification and Handling Policy [1], customer data is deleted within 90 days of the end of a contract unless the contract says otherwise.

rows.question: I accidentally emailed a customer file to the wrong person. What now?
rows.answer: Report the incident to the Data Protection Officer within 1 hour as a Security Incident [1]. This is considered a data breach, which may require notification to regulators and customers [1]. Do not forward the email or try to retrieve it, as this could compromise the incident further [2]. The Data Protection Officer will decide on the necessary actions, including notification [1].

rows.question: Within how many hours must regulators be told about a data breach?
rows.answer: According to [1], regulators must be notified within 72 hours of discovery.

rows.question: What are the Service Desk's opening hours?
rows.answer: The Service Desk is staffed from 08:00 to 20:00 IST, Monday to Friday. [1]

rows.question: What number do I call for IT support?
rows.answer: For P1 issues, call ext. 4357 (H-E-L-P). For other issues, use the service portal at help.kestrel.example or the "IT Help" chat in Microsoft Teams.

rows.question: How fast should a P2 ticket get a response?
rows.answer: According to IT-SVC-006, section 2. Ticket Priorities and SLAs, page 1 [1], a P2 High ticket should get a first response within 1 hour.

rows.question: Our whole team can't get into the billing system. What priority is that?
rows.answer:
Based on the policy excerpts, since the whole team is affected and a workaround exists, the priority is P3 Normal [1]. The Service Desk may change the priority if it does not match these definitions, but in this case, it seems to fit. 

To resolve the issue, please submit a ticket with the category "Software" [4] and provide more details about the issue.
unsupported_claims: The whole team is affected and a workaround exists

rows.question: Which ticket category should I pick for a VPN problem?
rows.answer: Based on the policy excerpts, the closest category for a VPN problem is Network/VPN [1].

rows.question: My ticket is way past its deadline. How do I escalate it?
rows.answer: To escalate your ticket, reply to the ticket with the word "escalate" and a reason. This will automatically escalate the ticket to the Service Desk Lead, and after twice the SLA time to the IT Operations Manager. [1]
unsupported_claims: after twice the SLA time to the IT Operations Manager

rows.question: My ticket was closed but the problem came back. Can I reopen it?
rows.answer: To reopen a closed ticket, you need to raise a new ticket and quote the old ticket number. This is stated in [1].
unsupported_claims: You need to reply within 5 business days of resolution to reopen it

rows.question: What information should I put in a support ticket?
rows.answer:
According to IT-SVC-006, section 6, you should include the following in a ticket:

* Your device name (shown in Company Portal)
* The exact error message or code
* When the problem started
* What you have already tried
* A screenshot if you can

Do not put passwords or MFA codes in the ticket. [1]

rows.question: When will a new joiner's accounts be ready?
rows.answer: According to the Access Management Policy [1], accounts for new hires are created 3 business days before their start date. Laptops are shipped to arrive at least 1 business day before the start date. This means that the new joiner's accounts will be ready at least 2 business days before their start date.
unsupported_claims: This means that the new joiner's accounts will be ready at least 2 business days before their start date.

rows.question: How do I get access to the production database?
rows.answer: To get access to the production database, you need to submit an Access Request through the service portal. Your manager and the system owner must approve the request. Additionally, Information Security must also approve the request, which will last for at most 30 days. After 30 days, you will need to submit a new request for continued access. [1]

rows.question: How long does production access last before I need to ask again?
rows.answer: Production access lasts at most 30 days. You need to renew it with a new request after that. [1]

rows.question: How often are access reviews done?
rows.answer: Access reviews are done every quarter for privileged and production access, and every six months for all other access [1].

rows.question: I moved to a new team. Will I keep my old access?
rows.answer: No, you will not keep your old access. According to [1], access from your old role is removed within 5 business days of the transfer date. Your new manager must request any access the new role needs.

rows.question: What happens to an employee's mailbox after they leave?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], mailboxes are kept for 90 days after an employee leaves. The manager can request that the leaver's email be forwarded to them for up to 30 days.

rows.question: When does a contractor's account expire?
rows.answer: A contractor's account expires on the contract end date or after 6 months, whichever comes first [1]. The sponsor must renew the account before it expires.

rows.question: Can my team share one login for a tool?
rows.answer: No, shared accounts used by people are not allowed [5]. You must create individual accounts for each team member. If you need to share access to a tool, consider using a 1Password shared vault [1].
unsupported_claims: If you need to share access to a tool, consider using a 1Password shared vault

rows.question: How often do service account credentials have to be rotated?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], service account credentials must be rotated every 90 days.

rows.question: I clicked a link in a weird email and typed in my password. What should I do?
rows.answer:
Disconnect from the network by turning off Wi-Fi or unplugging the cable, but do not shut down the laptop [1]. Call the security hotline on ext. 7100 straight away [1]. Change your password from another device or ask the Service Desk to reset it [1]. Write down what you clicked and when [1]. 

Note: If you're unsure whether the email was a simulation or not, reporting it with the Report Phishing button in Outlook is a safe choice [2].

rows.question: Should I turn off my laptop if I think it has malware?
rows.answer: No, do not shut down your laptop [1]. Disconnect from the network and call the security hotline on ext. 7100 straight away.

rows.question: How do I report a phishing email?
rows.answer: To report a phishing email, use the Report Phishing button in Outlook. This will send the message to Security Operations and remove it from your inbox. Do not forward suspicious emails to colleagues, reply to them, or click their links to check them. [1]

rows.question: What happens if I click on one of the fake phishing test emails?
rows.answer: If you click on a simulated phishing email, you will be assigned a 15-minute training module that must be completed within 7 days [1]. You will not be in immediate danger, as these are test emails. However, it's essential to report the simulation by clicking the Report Phishing button in Outlook to help improve our security measures [3].
unsupported_claims: You will not be in immediate danger, as these are test emails.

rows.question: How quickly does security respond to a SEV2 incident?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], a SEV2 incident (a likely compromise of a single user or device) requires a response within 1 hour.

rows.question: Is there a review after a major security incident?
rows.answer: Yes, a post-incident review is held within 10 business days of every SEV1 and SEV2 incident [1]. This review is blameless, focusing on causes and fixes, not assigning blame [1]. SEV1 and SEV2 incidents include confirmed data breaches and likely compromises of a single user or device [4]. These reviews are mandatory for SEV1 and SEV2 incidents.

rows.question: What's the maximum attachment size for email?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], email attachments are limited to 25 MB.

rows.question: How big is my mailbox?
rows.answer: According to [1], every employee receives a 100 GB mailbox.

rows.question: How do I create a shared mailbox for my team?
rows.answer:
To create a shared mailbox, follow these steps:

1. Submit an Access Request for the shared mailbox.
2. The request needs two named owners who will approve its membership.
3. The owners will be responsible for managing the membership of the shared mailbox.

[1]

rows.question: Can I add a client to our Teams channel?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], guests from outside Kestrel can be invited only to teams marked External, and guest access is reviewed every 90 days. Since you're asking about adding a client to a Teams channel, I assume you're referring to a team that's not marked External. In that case, you cannot add a client to a standard team. If you need to collaborate with a client, you should mark the team as External and follow the review process.
unsupported_claims: If you need to collaborate with a client, you should mark the team as External and follow the review process.

rows.question: Why did I lose my meeting room booking?
rows.answer: According to policy [1], a booking that is not checked in on the room panel within 10 minutes of its start time is released.

rows.question: How should I email a Confidential document?
rows.answer: To email a Confidential document, you must encrypt it by using the Encrypt button in Outlook [1]. This is the recommended method for sending Confidential data via email.

rows.question: Can I email someone an .iso file?
rows.answer: No, you cannot email someone an .iso file. According to [1], messages with executable attachments, such as .iso files, are blocked.

rows.question: How many days of paid parental leave do employees get?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.

rows.question: Can I bring my dog to the office?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.

rows.question: How do I claim reimbursement for my home internet bill?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.

rows.question: What is the Wi-Fi password for the Pune office guest network?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.

rows.question: Which Python version is installed on the build servers?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.

rows.question: When is the next company all-hands meeting?
rows.answer: I couldn't find this in the IT policies. Please raise a ticket at help.kestrel.example.
